exposure: prolonged requirement for neonatal intensive care
cohort: The participants were 200 high-risk newborns who required NICU stay for more than 48 hours, followed up for clinical assessment at 8-10 years of age.
finding: Babies with difficulties during the neonatal period, including prematurity and prolonged NICU stay, experienced higher immediate and long-term morbidities, with a notable percentage exhibiting behavioral issues and neurodevelopmental challenges at 8-10 years.
birth_weight: Included babies with low birth weight (46% of the cohort).
gest_age: Included preterm (33% born prior to 37 weeks) and term babies (67%).
